_comment: Copy this file to ground_truth.json and replace the entries with YOUR images. Each key is the exact filename inside eval/images/. Each value is the known-correct answer. Leave a field null if that image legitimately does not contain it (e.g. a card with no printed DOB) -- the harness will not penalize a field it has no label for. Use the SAME string formats the pipeline outputs: DOB as YYYY-MM-DD, name as 'Lastname, Firstname', RAMQ as 'AAAA 0000 0000'. Delete this _comment key (and the sample rows) before running.
